messages:
aya: quick q — for release notes and the console list, should patch tags be ordered by semver precedence or by release/time? wondering because our buildmeta and sha ordering is noisy :thinking:

michael: semver precedence for routing (so the highest patch wins) + display by release time in UI. keeps routing deterministic but UX shows most recent first. :+1:

sam: i lean display-by-time too. for humans, seeing latest deploys at top is nicer. plus docs-only bumps would be buried if we use semver strictly.

lee: small counter: our deploy-bot currently picks "latest" by semver desc when not pinned — that means if someone backports a patch with a higher metadata it could get chosen unexpectedly. we should decide what deploy-bot should do when buildmeta differs.

release-bot: deploy-bot behavior: default selection = highest semver core (major.minor.patch) then highest build metadata timestamp if present. pins override. example tags we accept:
```
1.2.3+build.20240301.shaabcd
1.2.4+canary.20240302.shaa12
1.2.3+backport.20240228.shaf00
```
Currently would pick 1.2.4 above 1.2.3 variants.

michael: agreed. question is display sorting only. we can add a small metadata field `display_ts` to make UI sort by release time but leave core semver for routing. ops-bot: any compatibility concerns?

ops-bot: main risk is mismatch between what humans expect (top of list) and what the router picks. That causes confusion during rollbacks if someone pins to the top-most UI entry. We should put a clear badge in console: "routing priority = semver" and an affordance to pin exact tag/sha.

aya: think consensus forming: 1) routing: semver precedence (major.minor.patch) + buildmeta timestamp tie-breaker 2) UI: sort by `display_ts` (newest first) with explicit badge showing routing key 3) deploy-bot CLI: make `--pin` more visible in the prompt and warn when pinning by list-index vs tag string.

sam: can we also normalize display names? e.g. show `1.2.3 (build 2024-03-01 · sha:abcd)` instead of long `+` string. less noise.

lee: +1. also add a small validation lint on tag creation that warns if someone creates a semver with nonstandard metadata (we had `+meta+extra` once).

michael: i'll open a tiny RFC and update deploy-bot logic to prefer semver core, then buildmeta ts. i'll add UI flags. aya — want to take docs update + release-notes template change?

aya: sure, i'll update the release-notes generator to use `display_ts` and normalized label. will include example snippets and the pinning caution.

release-bot: note: automated release-note job will include `display_ts` from the CI artifact timestamp going forward. older tags without it will fallback to created_at.

ops-bot: follow-up: add a short runbook step — "if UI shows top entry but router uses different tag, confirm tag string before pinning/rolling back". saved us one incident last month. :grimacing:

aya: thanks all. i'll post the RFC link here when ready and tag eng-release for review. :shipit:

michael: thanks — and can we grep the repo for weird tag patterns once RFC merges? i can add a CI check.

sam: <+1 emoji reaction>

lee: leaving this thread, follow-ups in the RFC PR.
